subject: PO mandate granularity — pilot onboarding carveout request
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sima Patel <sima@ledgerly.com>
Date: 2027-06-28T15:02:00Z
Subject: PO mandate granularity — pilot onboarding carveout request

Hi Sima,

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. Ledgerly's pilot looks like a strong fit for the integrations team and we'd like to move forward with a short trial (3 months, low volume). Before we kick off procurement, I wanted to surface a potential blocker on your side: our PO policy by default requires a PO for any new vendor subscription.

Given the pilot's size and the customer-requested timeline, would Ledgerly be open to a conditional carveout: onboarding via invoice-only for the pilot period, subject to the evidence checklist and a capped spend (up to $10k total)? We can provide the onboarding forms, sys-architecture security summary, and a MOA (memorandum of agreement) that limits liability and clarifies data handling.

If you need us to sign anything specific, attach it to your reply and we can route to legal. My ask is practical: allow the pilot to start without a formal PO while Procurement validates Ledgerly for standard PO processing in parallel.

Attached: onboarding-evidence-checklist.pdf (draft) — this is the list our procurement team typically uses for invoice-only pilots.

Next steps I propose:
- If Ledgerly accepts the conditional carveout, I’ll open a formal exception request to procurement and loop in Prio (cc’d) and Karthik for approval lane guidance.
- We’ll collect evidence per the checklist within 5 business days.

Can you confirm by EOD Wednesday?

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Growth Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0128


From: Sima Patel <sima@ledgerly.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Ops <procure@ledgerly.com>
Date: 2027-06-29T09:18:00Z
Subject: Re: PO mandate granularity — pilot onboarding carveout request

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear note. Ledgerly is happy to be flexible to make the trial work. We can do the invoice-only pilot under the conditions you proposed: capped spend $10k, evidence checklist completed, and a signed MOA that limits scope to the pilot. Procurement Ops on our side will want to confirm billing cadence (monthly invoice OK?) and the contact for remittance.

I’ve cc’d our procurement mailbox so they can flag any mandatory clauses. We’ll review your checklist and return a signed MOA by Friday if everything looks straightforward.

Sima Patel
Head of Partnerships | Ledgerly
sima@ledgerly.com | +1 212-555-9841

Attachment: none


From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Prio Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Sima Patel <sima@ledgerly.com>
Date: 2027-06-29T12:07:00Z
Subject: Fwd: PO mandate granularity — pilot onboarding carveout request

Prio / Karthik — forwarding Ledgerly's confirmation. They’ve agreed to invoice-only for the pilot with the standard constraints (cap $10k, evidence checklist, signed MOA). Sima has looped in their procurement team.

Quick context: Ledgerly is a data-intel startup we’ve been trialing in product; expected pilot spend is low but timing is aggressive — the integration team wants to start next week. I’m asking procurement for a temporary allowance so engineering can proceed while full vendor setup (and PO issuance) happens in parallel.

Key risk controls I recommend we require before activation:
- Completed onboarding-evidence-checklist (attaching the draft again).
- Signed MOA with scope limitation and indemnity language our legal is comfortable with (we’ll route draft to legal right after you sign the exception).
- Invoice-only billing cadence = monthly; payment terms NET30.
- A single procurement owner assigned to escalate any compliance gaps.

If you’re comfortable, can you: (a) advise which approval lane this falls under (low-risk small vendor?); (b) confirm if we should set a hard cap at $10k or $7.5k to be conservative; and (c) approve creation of a temporary vendor record flagged as "pilot-invoice-only" in the vendor portal?

Attachments: onboarding-evidence-checklist.pdf

Thanks — will stand by for your guidance.

— Marissa

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Prio Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Procurement Ops <procure@ledgerly.com>
Date: 2027-06-30T19:45:00Z
Subject: RE: PO mandate granularity — pilot onboarding carveout request

Thanks for the context — and good to see Ledgerly’s procurement is aligned.

Decision: I approve a controlled invoice-only onboarding for Ledgerly for the 3-month pilot under the following explicit conditions (these are non-negotiable):
1) Onboarding evidence must be complete and verified by our vendor intake checklist before any work begins.
2) MOA executed that includes data handling, scope-limited liability language, and termination for non-compliance. Legal will review the MOA — Marissa, loop in Legal and include a redline pass.
3) Hard spend cap set to $8,000 for the pilot. Any spend beyond requires explicit re-approval.
4) Billing cadence monthly, NET30, and Ledgerly to provide remittance contact.
5) Vendor record to be created in the portal as "pilot-invoice-only" and expires automatically after 90 days unless upgraded.

Prio / David — please create the exception request in Procure (PROC-4921), attach the checklist and MOA draft, and route to Legal for the redline. Prio, assign an owner for monitoring day-to-day compliance.

Marissa — once the MOA draft is back from Ledgerly and Legal signs off, confirm the start date and I’ll instruct finance to accept monthly invoices under the pilot record.

Karthik Iyer
Director, Procurement | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0142
